---
title: Theory Application Short Paper
---

The goal of this assignment is to apply a theoretical lens to a real organizational situation. Ideally, you will be able to use the theory to gain new insights into the situation, and will see something you wouldn't have noticed otherwise.

## What to do

**1. Choose a concept.** Pick one specific concept or theory from any chapter we've covered so far. 

**2. Find an example.** Identify a real-world situation that your concept can help explain. This can be something from your own experience in an organization or a current or recent event you've read about. Describe the situation briefly.

**3. Apply the theory.** Explain the concept in your own words and show how your example illustrates it. What does viewing the situation through the lens of the concept / framework reveal that you wouldn't otherwise see? Are there limitations to the theory? Are there aspects of this situation that remain unexplained or confusing? 

**4. Conclusion.** Reflect broadly on the broader implications of your analysis: what it reveals about organizations and communication? 

---

**Length:** 2–3 pages, double-spaced

**Format:** 12-point font, 1-inch margins. Cite the textbook (or any other course reading) if you quote or paraphrase it. You do not need a formal reference list for a brief citation, but do include enough information for me to find the source (author, chapter, page number).

**Submit:** Brightspace by Monday, Oct 26
